properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.home-page
properties.description: Required. It's used to specify the destination page from system error page. ex: 'public/show/page?id=home'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.title
properties.description: Optional. It's shown on the left side of the navbar. It can be localized by being defined at messages.properties. ex: 'AWS instance manager'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.title-account
properties.description: Optional. It's shown on the left side of the navbar when the site is in the state of login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.title' value is used. It can be localized by being defined at messages.properties. ex: 'AWS instance manager (logged in)'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.title-admin
properties.description: Optional. It's shown on the left side of the navbar when the site is in the state of admin login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.title' value is used. It can be localized by being defined at messages.properties. ex: 'AWS instance manager (admin)'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.image-path
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the image shown on the left side of the navbar. ex: '/images/bootstrap-logo.svg'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.image-path-account
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the image shown on the left side of the navbar when the site is in the state of login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.image-path' value is used.  ex: '/images/bootstrap-logo.svg'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.image-path-admin
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the image shown on the left side of the navbar when the site is in the state of admin login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.image-path' value is used.  ex: '/images/bootstrap-logo.svg'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.default-page-path
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the destination page. ex: '/public/show/page?id=home'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.default-page-path-account
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the destination page when the site is in the state of login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.default-page-path' value is used.  ex: '/public/show/page?id=home'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.default-page-path-admin
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the path of the destination page when the site is in the state of admin login. If it's not specified, 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.default-page-path' value is used.  ex: '/public/show/page?id=home'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.navbar.background-color-class
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the background color class of navbar. It's mainly used to clarify the environment (used in non-product environment). The default value is 'bg-color-navbar'.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.bootstrap.is-background-gradient
properties.description: Optional. It specifies whether the background of bootstrap components are gradient. default value is false.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.body.background-color
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the background-color of the page in the app. default value is '' (means white).

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.body.background-image
properties.description: Optional. It specifies the background-image of the page in the app. It's assumed to use linear-gradient color. default value is '' (means white).

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.process-result-message.shown-at-the-top
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.message.shown-at-the-top'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.process-result-message.shown-at-each-item
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.message.shown-at-each-item'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.switch-user.enabled
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.uses-switch-user'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.switch-user.switch-url
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.uses-switch-user'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.switch-user.exit-url
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.uses-switch-user'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.login.enabled
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.login.enabled'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.enabled
properties.description: A description for 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.enabled'

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.builtin-admin-login.password-plain
properties.description: Optional. The plain-text password for ecuacion-splib's built-in admin pages (HTTP Basic authentication, username 'ecuacion-splib'). Exactly one of this and 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.builtin-admin-login.password-bcrypt' must be set; if neither is set, the built-in admin pages are not accessible (fails closed).

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.builtin-admin-login.password-bcrypt
properties.description: Optional. A bcrypt hash of the password for ecuacion-splib's built-in admin pages (HTTP Basic authentication, username 'ecuacion-splib'). Exactly one of this and 'jp.ecuacion.splib.web.builtin-admin-login.password-plain' must be set; if neither is set, the built-in admin pages are not accessible (fails closed).

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.login-code.enabled
properties.description: Optional. Sends a 6-digit login code by mail after the password of the admin login, and requires it before /admin/** can be used (multi-factor authentication). Needs a SplibAdminAccountProvider bean and the mail settings. Default: false. See jp.ecuacion.splib.web.adminlogin.SplibAdminLoginProtection.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.session-check.enabled
properties.description: Optional. Logs out the session of an admin on /admin/** (and while switched to another user) when the account cannot log in anymore or its stamp (mail address, role, password hash, and so on) has changed since the login. Needs a SplibAdminAccountProvider bean. Default: false. See jp.ecuacion.splib.web.adminlogin.SplibAdminLoginProtection.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.attempt-limit.enabled
properties.description: Optional. Rejects the admin login of a login ID with too many wrong passwords without checking the password. Default: false. See jp.ecuacion.splib.web.adminlogin.SplibAdminLoginProtection.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.password-failure.max-attempts
properties.description: Optional. The number of wrong passwords of a login ID allowed in password-failure.window-minutes. Default: 10.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.password-failure.window-minutes
properties.description: Optional. The minutes in which wrong passwords are counted. Default: 15.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.code-resend.max-attempts
properties.description: Optional. The number of times the login code can be resent in code-resend.window-minutes. Default: 5.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.code-resend.window-minutes
properties.description: Optional. The minutes in which resending the login code is counted. Default: 60.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.code-failure.max-attempts
properties.description: Optional. The number of wrong login codes of a login ID allowed in code-failure.window-minutes, counted across the codes (logging in again does not reset it). Default: 10.

properties.name: jp.ecuacion.splib.web.admin-login.code-failure.window-minutes
properties.description: Optional. The minutes in which wrong login codes are counted. Default: 60.
